subject: FY28 governance sprint: roles, budget safety-net & QBR deliverables
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, Beth Warren <beth@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-10-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: FY28 governance sprint: roles, budget safety-net & QBR deliverables

Team — launching a short governance sprint to lock owners and safety-net triggers for FY28 planning + QBR deliverables. Goal is to reduce ambiguity on who owns scenario modelling, who signs contingency bands, and which artifacts we bring to the QBR.

High-level asks (please reply with owner + ETA):
- Scenario owners: define 3 budget scenarios (base / downside / downside+). Owner & deliverable due Oct 25.
- Safety-net bands: propose top-level trigger table (revenue, headcount, usage cost) and fallback playbooks. Owner + draft by Oct 22.
- QBR pack: finalize slides, data sources, and executive notes. Use the attached QBR-materials-template.pptx. Slide deck draft by Oct 29.
- Dependencies: headcount assumptions (Laura), model cost sensitivity (Aditya), external channel impacts (Jonas).

Beth — looping you in for visibility on the Acme contract exposure; if you have requests for the QBR pack, flag them here.

I'll consolidate owners and circulate a short action tracker by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Planning
Redwood Inference

Attachment: QBR-materials-template.pptx (pptx, 4 slides template)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, aditya.rao@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, Beth Warren <beth@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FY28 governance sprint: roles, budget safety-net & QBR deliverables

Thanks — happy to take the external channel impact scenario.

A couple of notes:
- Recommend a short taxonomy for scenarios: Frequency shock (usage drop), Price shock (pooled infra cost increase), AND Revenue slip (ACV pushouts). Keep it to 3 for clarity.
- For safety-net triggers, propose we define both signal (metric + threshold) and action (3-step: pause non-essential hires, slow feature launches, engage sales incentives).

I'll add a one-pager for the Channel Impact scenario by Oct 23.

Taking headcount assumptions and baseline comp modeling.

- I'll map comp and offer slippage risk to the downside scenarios; draft with numbers by Oct 24.
- Need a small decision point: do we prefer to keep hiring control at PLG/Eng managers or centralize approvals under FP&A for the safety-net? I recommend centralizing critical approvals for hires above IC+2 until Q1 results.
